# draw.io viewer

Unmodified `viewer-static.min.js` from draw.io **v32.5.5**, distributed under the
included Apache 2.0 license. The bundle retains its upstream dependency notices.

Source: https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/v32.5.5/src/main/webapp/js/viewer-static.min.js

The Studio loads this bundle only inside the architecture viewer iframe. Basic
shapes, local diagrams, and Studio controls require no remote draw.io service.
Editable architecture files are generated in `public/diagrams/` for every use case.
